select droi.platform_order_id, droi.source_platform, droi.shop_name, droi.item_total, round(droi.item_total * droi.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, droi.cny_settle_amount, droi.buyer_name, droi.man_phone, droi.second_phone, droi.man_street, droi.second_street, droi.country_name_cn, droi.order_state, droi.correction_status, droi.create_time, droi.platform_order_id, droi.delivery_time, droi.charge_name from dmp_return_order_info droi
and droi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and droi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and droi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and droi.order_state = #{params.orderState}
and to_char(droi.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{params.createTime_begin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(droi.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{params.createTime_end},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(droi.delivery_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{params.deliveryTime_begin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(droi.delivery_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{params.deliveryTime_end},'yyyy-MM-dd')
